name: io.github.ramdhavepreetam/nervapack
title: NervaPack
description: Offline codebase knowledge graph: 91% token reduction vs naive RAG, plus cross-session agent memory.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Vector search → K-Hop BFS → focused Markdown context with token savings summary

tools.name: graph_status
tools.description: Node/edge counts by type, language breakdown, unsynced file warnings

tools.name: explore
tools.description: Browse all indexed classes, functions, imports, and markdown docs

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Reverse dependency analysis — find what breaks if a given entity changes

tools.name: memory_store
tools.description: Persist a fact, decision, outcome, procedure, or preference with entity links

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: FTS5 search → graph expansion → scored, budget-capped recall

tools.name: memory_about
tools.description: Entity dossier: all current facts/decisions linked to one entity

tools.name: memory_why
tools.description: Explain a decision: rationale, rejected alternatives, caused outcomes

tools.name: memory_timeline
tools.description: Chronological trace including superseded versions

tools.name: memory_end_session
tools.description: Close session with an outcome summary and queue consolidation

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Tombstone (soft-delete) or hard-purge memory nodes

tools.name: memory_verify
tools.description: Confirm or refute a memory node, adjusting confidence

tools.name: memory_start_session
tools.description: Open a named session with optional namespace

tools.name: memory_list_sessions
tools.description: List all sessions with node counts, newest first

tools.name: memory_clear_session
tools.description: Tombstone or hard-purge all nodes belonging to a session

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Node counts, DB size, top entities by degree, all namespaces

tools.name: memory_for_code
tools.description: Memories that TOUCH a source file, optionally at a specific line

tools.name: memory_to_code
tools.description: Code locations a memory node TOUCHES (file, line range)

tools.name: memory_import
tools.description: Bulk-seed memory from a JSON array of node specs

tools.name: memory_switch_namespace
tools.description: Switch the active memory namespace, resetting the active session

tools.name: memory_verify_staleness
tools.description: Scan TOUCHES edges and flag memories whose source file changed since stored
